_readme: Manual CLASS OVERRIDES for the module map (plan 21 §3.1). The build COMPUTES defaults: OWNER_SEEDED files → owner; a module containing a canonical placeholder, or a skill frontmatter → adaptive; everything else → static. Add an entry here ONLY when the computed default is wrong. Format: { "<deploy dest>": { "default": "static|adaptive|owner", "modules": { "<full heading line>": "class" } } }. A stale override (unknown file/signature) FAILS the build — rename-aware by design.
_classes: static = upstream-owned, mechanically replaceable · adaptive = carries project values, replaced with value transfer · owner = the owner's content, never in the machinery's scope
